svg.text: Prototype 1: Module Connections (Hall ID + ESP-NOW + 2 power contacts)
Exploded side view. All DSP runs on the Core in stack order. No audio passes through the modules. 2026-11-02
Owned Bluetooth speaker sits in the cradle
Corner magnets hold the faces together and set the rotation (alternate N/S).
Keep code spots ≥15 mm from the corner magnets, then check the Hall readings (CAD C2).
Spring-loaded pogo pins on the bottom land on the flat pads on top when the faces snap.
Levels = the modules stacked bottom to top (e.g. ADSR → Reverb → EQ).
How the Core finds the order
1. Core reads its own top-face Halls: the ID of the block directly above it.
2. Each module sends {my_id, above_id, knobs} every ~50 ms over ESP-NOW.
3. Core links the IDs upward: Core → ADSR → Reverb → EQ → speaker (SSS).
4. A module silent for >200 ms counts as removed, and the chain rebuilds with a short fade.
Linear Hall sensor (49E), read on 3.3 V
5 V rail (passes up through every module)
